note: Domains and weights follow Microsoft's published skills-measured outline for AZ-104, 'Skills measured as of April 17, 2026'. Always check learn.microsoft.com for the current official breakdown before your exam, as Microsoft periodically revises exam blueprints.

domains.name: Manage Azure identities and governance
subtopics: Manage Microsoft Entra users and groups (creation, properties, licences)
Manage external users and configure self-service password reset
Manage access to Azure resources with built-in roles and scoped assignments
Implement and manage Azure Policy, resource locks, and tags
Manage subscriptions, resource groups, and management groups
Manage costs with alerts, budgets, and Azure Advisor recommendations

domains.name: Implement and manage storage
subtopics: Create and configure storage accounts and choose a redundancy option
Configure storage firewalls, SAS tokens, stored access policies, and access keys
Configure identity-based access for Azure Files
Configure Blob Storage containers, tiers, versioning, and lifecycle management
Configure Azure Files shares, snapshots, and soft delete
Move data with Azure Storage Explorer and AzCopy, and configure object replication

domains.name: Deploy and manage Azure compute resources
subtopics: Interpret, modify, and deploy ARM templates and Bicep files
Create and configure virtual machines, sizes, disks, and encryption at host
Deploy virtual machines to availability zones and sets, and configure scale sets
Provision containers with Azure Container Registry, Container Instances, and Container Apps
Create and configure App Service plans, TLS, custom domains, slots, and backup

domains.name: Implement and manage virtual networking
subtopics: Create and configure virtual networks, subnets, and virtual network peering
Configure public IP addresses and user-defined routes
Create network security groups and application security groups, and evaluate effective rules
Implement Azure Bastion, service endpoints, and private endpoints
Configure Azure DNS and internal or public load balancers
Troubleshoot network connectivity and load balancing

domains.name: Monitor and maintain Azure resources
subtopics: Interpret metrics and configure log settings in Azure Monitor
Query and analyse logs, and use Azure Monitor Insights
Set up alert rules, action groups, and alert processing rules
Use Azure Network Watcher and Connection monitor
Create Recovery Services and Backup vaults and configure backup policies
Configure Azure Site Recovery and perform a failover to a secondary region
